text:
Noah: Heads-up — small spike in SSE reconnect jitter around 2026-10-04T18:12Z. Console shows a weird pattern: resume succeeds but client reconnects again ~200ms later.

sana: Saw that too. Traces indicate server accepted resume (resume_ok=true) but the post-resume token negotiation returned a newer kv_version and clients do a defensive reconnect.

Lena: kv_version mismatch? That's from the model KV cache namespace right? If the runtime compacts or checkpoint-rolls during a request, clients might see incompatible cache.

ara: Root cause: when we promoted a new route variant the kv_namespace was renumbered for compacted caches. Edge returns resume_ok but the runtime later sends `kv_version: v2` and some client libs treat that as inconsistent and reconnect.

Noah: Sample sanitized trace:
```
2026-10-04T18:12:02.101Z route=chat slab=slab-3 session=aaa resume_ok=true kv_version=v1
2026-10-04T18:12:02.289Z route=chat slab=slab-3 session=aaa kv_version=v2 client_reconnect=1 reason="kv_mismatch"
```

sana: That 188ms gap is killing our reconnection budget and causing duplicate billing. Billing shows ~900 duplicate starts in the 15m window.

billing-bot: ticket BILL-2026-999 opened for duplicate session meter.

Lena: UX/console ask: emit `kv_version` and `route_variant_commit` in reconnect events and show them in the reconnect timeline. Also tag reconnects with `handoff_hint=kv-compact` vs `handoff_hint=drain` etc. Makes filtering easier.

ara: On the runtime side I can avoid returning resume_ok until kv_version is stabilized for the session's namespace. That would add ~50ms median latency on resume but should eliminate the two-step reconnect. We could gate this behind a flag.

Noah: For short term, can we add a telemetry tag `kv_version_delta` and a console alert that triggers when >0.1% of resumes return a different kv_version within 1s?

Lena: Yes. I'll add a dashboard panel `resume_kv_drift` and an alert rule that attaches `route_variant_commit` to the alert payload so oncall can see the commit that caused the drift.

ara: Also plan: runtime PR to delay resume_ok until kv stable (opt-in flag), and a proxy log field `kv_version=...` to correlate. Will add backcompat toggle. ETA PR in ~40m.

Noah: Billing mitigation: propose a grace window (default 1s) where reconnections that present the same resume_token and show kv_version drift are not billed as new sessions. Gate by account flag.

billing-bot: recorded proposal for opt-in grace window keyed by resume_token + kv_version drift.

sana: DevEx action: publish client guidance to keep resume_token across kv_version bumps when server indicates `handoff_hint=kv-compact`. We'll add a short snippet for JS/Go libs.

Lena: Action items recap: 1) @ara runtime flag + PR to stabilize kv before resume_ok, 2) @Lena add `resume_kv_drift` panel and alert with commit metadata, 3) @billing-bot prototype 1s grace-window opt-in, 4) DevEx publish client guidance.

oncall-bot: note: if reconnect rate > 0.5% for 5m, auto-pause variant rollout.

Noah: Great. If this reoccurs I'll flip the rollout. Ping me and I'll pause the canary. Thanks everyone.
